caveats: Each variant is refitted and its threshold recalibrated on validation; test is used once per variant.

Deltas: IsolationForest uses seed-paired differences (mean +/- std over seeds) for the point estimate, and a window bootstrap on the primary seed for the interval; the two sources of uncertainty are separate.
Bootstrap resamples windows independently although incidents span several windows: intervals are optimistic.
Leave-one-family-out can understate a family whose signal is duplicated elsewhere; see the only_* variants.
The test split has only 23 attack windows; small deltas are noise unless the CI excludes 0.
Synthetic data: attacker IPs are partly planted in the blocklist, so the threat_intel family is circular.
